message: Elvera, have you contacted an attorney to help with your T-Netix issues?  T-Netix is a corrupt, decietful, lying, etc., company!  I am going to make a complaint against them with the DBM.  I am also interested in the next bid proposal for inmate telephone systems in Maryland.  There are some reputable companies out here.  Hopefully, one can win the bid and we can be rid of T-netix!!
